top_concerns: Claims of outperforming QD baselines are not supported: LQD(F+N) is below DNS, robotics uses fitness-only LQD(F), and no QD score/coverage is reported there
Robotics gain over GA is not statistically significant; missing strong fitness-only baselines (e.g., CMA-ES, tuned GA, fitness sharing) and baseline tuning details
Emergent diversity claim is overinterpreted; no causal control and novelty metric is partially circular
Discovered algorithm is a black-box transformer with only qualitative heatmap interpretation; expressivity claims ('any QD algorithm') unsupported
Incremental over LGA/LES; generalization evidence thin (two functions in scaling study, closely related OOD functions, single selected meta-trained model)
